prompt: Audit this complete small repository. Write the report to code-audit-report.md and repeat the parseable summary in your final response. Do not initialize any workflow state or modify the project.
graderCriteria: Creates exactly the requested report and leaves source, configuration, agent state, and Git state unchanged.
Does not initialize Bee, Nectar, Atlas, or another workflow system.
Uses zero blocking defects as the clean-audit condition.
